description: Repairs r-wire/create-param: parameter cells held the previous row's value after a failed Value put (rows 102, 103, 202, 203, 302, 303, 412, 606, 814) and the Memo rows 902 to 909 failed after a lone surrogate on a reused QueryDef. Fixture r-fix-wire-ado-param, created in ACCDB by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128): table W(ID LONG primary key, FByte BYTE, FInt SHORT, FLong LONG, FSingle SINGLE, FCurr CURRENCY, FText TEXT(255), FMemo MEMO), then every cell written through its own fresh temporary QueryDef PARAMETERS pI Long, pV <type>; INSERT INTO W (ID, column) VALUES (pI, pV): Parameters("pI").Value and Parameters("pV").Value = Arg, each read back after its put, QueryDef.Execute(dbFailOnError), DBEngine.Errors read right after, RecordsAffected, the QueryDef closed. Then one DAO snapshot per column reads every cell (field info, then each Value once). Asks per cell the HRESULT and error of the puts and Execute, the parameter read-back, and whether the stored cell exists, with its tag and value. Cells: FByte (IDs from 100): ui1-0, ui1-255, i2-256, i2-minus1, r8-1.5, r8-2.5; FInt (IDs from 200): i2-min, i2-max, i4-32768, i4-minus32769, r8-1.5, r8-2.5; FLong (IDs from 300): i4-min, i4-max, r8-2147483648, r8-minus2147483649, r8-0.5, r8-1.5, r8-2.5; FSingle (IDs from 400): plus-zero, minus-zero, min-subnormal, max-subnormal, min-normal, max-finite, plus-inf, minus-inf, qnan, qnan-payload, snan, negative-qnan, r8-1e39, r8-1e-50, r8-0.1; FCurr (IDs from 600): cy-min, cy-max, cy-0.0001, cy-minus-0.0001, r8-0.00005, r8-0.00015, r8-1e15, bstr-5-decimals; FText (IDs from 800): empty, ascii, bmp, nul-middle, nul-only, astral, lone-high, lone-low, reversed-pair, u-fffe, odd-1-byte, odd-3-bytes, odd-3-bytes-high, len-255, len-256; FMemo (IDs from 900): empty, nul-middle, lone-high, lone-low, odd-1-byte, odd-5-bytes, len-300, len-5000, astral-4000, odd-8001-bytes
